item.description:
📸 My Photography Journey
#

Welcome to my complete photography collection! Each image tells a story and captures a moment that caught my eye.

🌅 Landscape & Nature
# 

<div style="border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); background: white;">
  <img src="/img/Project_1.jpg" alt="Golden Gate Bridge Sunset" style="width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover;">
  <div style="padding: 1.5rem;">
    <h4 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #1f2937;">Golden Gate Bridge Sunset</h4>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 1rem 0; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5;">
      Captured during golden hour from Crissy Field. The fog rolling in created this perfect silhouette against the warm sky.
    </p>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <span style="background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem;">Golden Hour</span>
      <span style="background: #dbeafe; color: #1e40af; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem;">San Francisco</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div style="border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); background: white;">
  <img src="/img/Project_2.jpg" alt="Bay Area Mountain Trail" style="width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover;">
  <div style="padding: 1.5rem;">
    <h4 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #1f2937;">Bay Area Mountain Trail</h4>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 1rem 0; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5;">
      Early morning hike in the hills above Silicon Valley. The layers of mountains create beautiful depth in the composition.
    </p>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <span style="background: #dcfce7; color: #166534; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem;">Nature</span>
      <span style="background: #f3e8ff; color: #7c3aed; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem;">Hiking</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

🏙️ Urban & Architecture
# 

<div style="border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); background: white;">
  <img src="/img/Project_3.png" alt="Downtown Architecture" style="width: 100%; height: 250px; object-fit: cover;">
  <div style="padding: 1.5rem;">
    <h4 style="margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0; color: #1f2937;">Urban Geometry</h4>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 1rem 0; color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5;">
      The interplay of lines, shadows, and reflections in downtown San Francisco creates fascinating geometric patterns.
    </p>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <span style="background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem;">Architecture</span>
      <span style="background: #fed7d7; color: #c53030; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.75rem;">Urban</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

📱 Mobile Photography
#

iPhone Photography

Some of my favorite shots are captured spontaneously with my iPhone. The best camera is the one you have with you!
